reason: The inference '||P_R|| >= 1-t >= 1/2, so P_R is nonvanishing' is invalid under the registered def-delta-projection. Nonvanishing means that the second alternative | ||P_R||-1 | <= O(t+epsilon_A) holds; a lower bound away from zero alone does not establish that quantitative closeness to norm one. The extended t-inclusion also supplies the missing upper bound ||P_R|| <= 1+t, and combining both bounds would yield | ||P_R||-1 | <= t <= t+epsilon_A with explicit coefficient 1, but node 1.2 neither states nor uses this required step. Thus its stated reasoning does not establish the nonvanishing hypothesis needed by the nested-corner and outer-compression externals.
